connector.name: LINZA
connector.registryDescription: Local-first MCP sidecar for Markdown artifacts, review intents, and supervised knowledge growth.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package linza-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the semiotronika account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: LINZA_VAULT
env.description: Absolute path to the Markdown workspace or vault LINZA may index. Defaults to ./vault.

env.name: LINZA_EMBED_PROVIDER
env.description: Embedding provider. Allowed values: lmstudio, openai, ollama. Default: lmstudio.

env.name: LINZA_EMBED_URL
env.description: Embedding API base URL when LINZA_EMBED_PROVIDER is lmstudio, openai, or ollama.

env.name: LINZA_BRIDGE_THRESHOLD
env.description: Semantic bridge threshold as a floating-point string. Default: 0.55.

env.name: LINZA_MAX_BRIDGE_PAIRS
env.description: Maximum note pairs for semantic bridge rebuilds. Default: 1000000. Use 0 to disable the guard.

env.name: LINZA_DEFAULT_PROFILE
env.description: Default search profile name. Defaults to general.

env.name: LINZA_LANGUAGE
env.description: User-facing guide language. Allowed values: auto, en, ru. Default: auto.
